payload.text: Hi, can I book a table for six on Friday at 8pm?
Hi, can I book a table for six on Friday at 8pm?

For parties of six or more, we can book our private room upstairs. The room hire is £15 per head, and we take a 25% deposit to secure the booking. The kitchen also needs a pre-order from your group two days before the date.

The room is yours for Friday at 8pm, and our events team will send out the paperwork by email and take care of everything from here. Is there anything else I can help you with?
